items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that over a site with subcanonical topology the lower shriek along a localization is computed without sheafification, by the coproduct displayed, so that the description of the companion lemma needs no sheafification (statement lines 6267-6282). The proof is a complete verification of the sheaf condition for the describing presheaf: the restrictions of a compatible family are described and shown to force equality of the morphisms on the pairwise products (proof lines 6285-6300); subcanonicality then provides a unique morphism gluing them and the sheaf condition for the given sheaf glues the sections (proof lines 6301-6307), which is exactly what is needed. The non-formal content is the verification of the sheaf condition. The claim is H2: a written-out verification with each input named.
